events.config: --[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() function cl(v,a,b)return math.max(a,math.min(b,v))end function note_off(e) if e.on and e.ln>=0 then local k=e.lc*128+e.ln if own[k]==e then gms(e.lc,144,e.ln,0) own[k]=nil end end e.on=false e.gate=0 end function refresh_lane(i) local e=ele[i] if e:bva()>0 then glc(i,1,0,100,255,0) glp(i,1,cl((out_mode==2 and e.dn or e.n)*2,80,255)) else glc(i,1,255,0,0,0) glp(i,1,20) end end function init_lane(i) local e=ele[i] local k=cl(e.division_index or 7,1,#lane_divs) e:bmo(1)e:emi(1)e:ema(#lane_divs) e.division_index=k e.divisions=lane_divs[k] e:eva(k)e:bva(0) e.c=-1 e.n=e.n or rootNote glc(i,2,255,255,255,0)glp(i,2,0) e.ln=-1 e.lc=ch e.on=false e.gate=0 e.wait=0 e.fl=0 refresh_lane(i) end init_lane(n)

--[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() init_lane(n) function apply_scale() local s=scales[currentScale] for i=0,7 do ele[i].n=s and cl(rootNote+s[i+1],0,127) or rootNote refresh_lane(i) end end function scale_led() local c=out_mode==2 and drum_cols[drum_map] or scale_cols[currentScale] or{255,255,255} local m=mode_cols[out_mode] glc(12,1,c[1],c[2],c[3]) glp(12,1,255) glc(12,2,m[1],m[2],m[3]) glp(12,2,out_mode>1 and 255 or 0) end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) function cx(x,y) local t=ele[x]:bst()>0 and y+4 or y local e=ele[t] local f=out_mode==2 and "dn" or "n" e[f]=cl(e[f]+(ele[x]:est()>63 and 1 or -1),0,127) refresh_lane(t) glp(x,2,180) print("lane "..t.." note:"..e[f]) end function lane_btn(s) local i=s:ind() if s:bva()==0 then note_off(s) s.wait=0 glp(i,2,0) end refresh_lane(i) end function lane_enc(s) local k=cl(s:eva(),1,#lane_divs) s.division_index=k s.divisions=lane_divs[k] if rnd_snap then rnd_snap[s:ind()]=k end refresh_lane(s:ind()) print("lane "..s:ind().." div:"..s.divisions) end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) function play(x,e) note_off(e) local c=out_mode==2 and drum_ch or out_mode==3 and x or ch local n=cl(out_mode==2 and e.dn or e.n,0,127) local k=c*128+n local o=own[k] if o and o.st==pos then o.on=false e.pg=math.max(e.pg,o.gate) else if o then note_off(o) end used[c]=true gms(c,144,n,127) end own[k]=e e.st=pos e.ln=n e.lc=c e.on=true e.gate=e.pg e.fl=clock_pulses glp(x,2,255) end function lane_tick(x) local e=ele[x] e.c=e.c+1 if e.c>=e.divisions then e.c=0 end if e.c==0 and e:bva()>0 then if e.wait>0 then e.wait=0 play(x,e) end local u=math.min(2*clock_pulses,12) local d=pos%(2*u)==u and (swing*u+6)//12 or 0 e.pg=math.max(1,math.floor(e.divisions*clock_pulses*gate_pct/100+0.5)) if d>0 then e.wait=d else play(x,e) end end end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) rnd_pool={1,1,1,1,3,3,3,3,5,5,5,5,7,7,7,7,2,2,4,4,6,6,8,9} rnd_ivs={4,8,16,32,64} rnd_on=false function set_div(i,k) local l=ele[i] l.division_index=k l.divisions=lane_divs[k] l:eva(k) l.c=-1 refresh_lane(i) end function rnd_restore() local s=ele[14].counter for i=0,7 do set_div(i,rnd_snap[i]) if s>=0 then ele[i].c=s%ele[i].divisions end end rnd_snap=nil end function random_tick() local e=ele[14] e.counter=e.counter+1 local on=rnd_on local hold=e.division_index>#rnd_ivs if on and not hold and e.counter%e.divisions==0 then glc(14,2,grnd(),grnd(),grnd()) glc(14,1,grnd(),grnd(),grnd()) glp(14,2,255) for i=0,7 do if ele[i]:bva()>0 then set_div(i,rnd_pool[grnd()%#rnd_pool+1]) end end else glp(14,2,on and (hold and 150 or 60) or 0) end end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) function sequencer_tick() globalCounter=(globalCounter+1)%16 random_tick() for i=0,7 do lane_tick(i)end glp(15,2,globalCounter==0 and 255 or(globalCounter%4==0 and 50 or 0)) end function reset_sequence() globalCounter=-1 pos=-1 midi_clock_counter=clock_pulses-1 for i=0,7 do local e=ele[i] note_off(e)e.c=-1 e.ln=-1 e.wait=0 e.fl=0 glp(i,2,0) end ele[14].counter=-1 glp(14,2,0)glp(15,2,0) end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) function stop_sequence() transport_running=false for i=0,7 do note_off(ele[i]) ele[i].wait=0 glp(i,2,0) end for c in pairs(used) do gms(c,176,123,0) end used={} own={} glp(14,2,0)glp(15,2,0) end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() init_lane(num) function rt(b) if b==248 then if boot_clock then boot_clock=false transport_running=true reset_sequence() end if transport_running then pos=pos+1 gate_tick() midi_clock_counter=(midi_clock_counter+1)%clock_pulses if midi_clock_counter==0 then sequencer_tick()end end elseif b==250 then boot_clock=false transport_running=true reset_sequence() elseif b==251 then boot_clock=false transport_running=true elseif b==252 then boot_clock=false stop_sequence() end end
--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() if self:bva()>0 then glc(num,1,255,0,255,0)glp(num,1,180) else glc(num,1,0,100,255,0)glp(num,1,50) end
--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() if self:bva()>0 then glc(num,1,255,0,255,0)glp(num,1,180) else glc(num,1,0,100,255,0)glp(num,1,50) end
--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() if self:bva()>0 then glc(num,1,255,0,255,0)glp(num,1,180) else glc(num,1,0,100,255,0)glp(num,1,50) end
--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() if self:bva()>0 then glc(num,1,255,0,255,0)glp(num,1,180) else glc(num,1,0,100,255,0)glp(num,1,50) end

--[[@cb]] drum_maps={{36,38,42,46,39,37,45,49},{36,37,38,39,40,41,42,43},{36,38,43,47,50,37,42,46}} drum_names={"GM","C1 chromatic","TR"} drum_cols={{255,0,0},{0,255,0},{0,0,255}} mode_cols={{0,0,0},{255,255,255},{0,255,255}} mode_names={"scale","drum","multi"} drum_map=1 function apply_drums() local m=drum_maps[drum_map] for i=0,7 do ele[i].dn=m[i+1] refresh_lane(i) end end function mode_enc(s) if out_mode==2 then s:emi(1)s:ema(#drum_maps)s:eva(drum_map) else s:emi(0)s:ema(7)s:eva(currentScale) end end self:bmo(0)self:bva(0) apply_drums() mode_enc(self) scale_led()
--[[@cb]] if self:bva()>0 then out_mode=out_mode%3+1 mode_enc(self) scale_led() for i=0,7 do refresh_lane(i) end print("mode:"..mode_names[out_mode]) end

--[[@cb]] if out_mode==2 then drum_map=cl(self:eva(),1,#drum_maps) apply_drums() print("drums:"..drum_names[drum_map]) else currentScale=self:eva() apply_scale() print("scale:"..currentScale) end scale_led()

--[[@cb]] gate_cols={{0,255,255},{0,255,0},{255,180,0},{255,0,0}} self:emo(1)self:ev0(50)self:emi(10)self:ema(80) self:eva(gate_pct)self:bmo(0) sw_hold=false sw_lock=false function gate_led() local p=gate_pct local k=p<=20 and 1 or p<=40 and 2 or p<=60 and 3 or 4 local c=gate_cols[k] glc(13,1,c[1],c[2],c[3])glp(13,1,math.max(40,p*3)) glc(13,2,255,0,255)glp(13,2,swing>0 and 120 or 0) end function gate_tick() for i=0,7 do local e=ele[i] if e.on and e.gate>0 then e.gate=e.gate-1 if e.gate==0 then note_off(e)end end if e.fl>0 then e.fl=e.fl-1 if e.fl==0 then glp(i,2,0)end end if e.wait>0 then e.wait=e.wait-1 if e.wait==0 then play(i,e)end end end end gate_led()
--[[@cb]] sw_hold=self:bva()>0 if sw_hold then swing=swing>0 and 0 or 4 print("swing:"..(swing>0 and "67%" or "off")) else sw_lock=true gtt(13,250) end gate_led()
--[[@cb]] if not sw_hold and not sw_lock then gate_pct=cl(gate_pct+(self:est()>63 and 5 or -5),10,80) self:eva(gate_pct) print("gate:"..gate_pct.."%") gate_led() end

--[[@cb]] local num=self:ind() self:bmo(0)self:emi(1)self:ema(#rnd_ivs+1) self.division_index=3 self:eva(3) self.divisions=rnd_ivs[3] self:bva(0)self.counter=-1 glp(num,1,0)glp(num,2,0) glc(num,1,255,0,255)glc(num,2,255,0,255) function clock_led() local c=clock_cols[clock_index] glc(15,1,c[1],c[2],c[3])glp(15,1,clock_index*50) end clock_led()

--[[@cb]] if self:bva()==0 then return end if not rnd_on then rnd_on=true if not rnd_snap then rnd_snap={} for i=0,7 do rnd_snap[i]=ele[i].division_index end end print("random on") elseif self.division_index>#rnd_ivs then rnd_on=false rnd_snap=nil print("random off, pattern kept") else rnd_on=false if rnd_snap then rnd_restore() end print("random off, pattern restored") end glp(14,2,rnd_on and 60 or 0)
--[[@cb]] local k=cl(self:eva(),1,#rnd_ivs+1) self.division_index=k if k>#rnd_ivs then print("random: hold") else self.divisions=rnd_ivs[k] print("random every "..self.divisions.." steps") end

--[[@cb]] local n=self:ind() self:emo(1)self:ev0(50)self:emi(1)self:ema(#clock_divs) self:eva(clock_index)self:bmo(0) glc(n,2,255,255,255)glp(n,2,0) apply_scale() local z=ele[#ele] z.rtmrx_cb=function(s,h,b) rt(b) end z.midirx_cb=function(s,h,e) local a,k,v=e[2],e[3],e[4] if a>=144 and a<=159 and v>0 then rootNote=k apply_scale() print("rootNote:"..rootNote) end end rx_mode(0,3)rx_mode(2,3)

--[[@cb]] clock_index=cl(clock_index+(self:est()>63 and 1 or -1),1,#clock_divs) clock_pulses=clock_divs[clock_index] midi_clock_counter=midi_clock_counter%clock_pulses self:eva(clock_index) clock_led() print("clock:"..clock_labels[clock_index])

--[[@cb]] rootNote=rootNote or 60 ch=0 drum_ch=9 out_mode=1 used={} own={} swing=0 pos=-1 gate_pct=math.max(10,math.min(80,gate_pct or 50)) currentScale=math.max(0,math.min(7,currentScale or 1)) lane_divs={2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,32} clock_divs={3,6,12,24} clock_labels={"1/32","1/16","1/8","1/4"} clock_cols={{0,255,255},{0,120,255},{255,0,255},{255,180,0}} clock_index=math.max(1,math.min(#clock_divs,clock_index or 2)) clock_pulses=clock_divs[clock_index] midi_clock_counter=clock_pulses-1 globalCounter=-1 transport_running=false boot_clock=true scales={ {0,2,4,5,7,9,11,12},{0,2,3,5,7,9,10,12}, {0,1,3,5,7,8,10,12},{0,2,4,6,7,9,11,12}, {0,2,4,5,7,9,10,12},{0,2,3,5,7,8,10,12}, {0,1,3,5,6,8,10,12} } scale_cols={ {255,0,0},{255,127,0},{255,255,0},{0,255,0}, {0,0,255},{75,0,130},{148,0,211} }
